text:
Make a website for Riverside Run 2027, a city running event in Pune. Runners should be able to compare the three races, work out what they will pay with a fee calculator, register with a form, see the race-day and expo-day schedule, see the route and water stations for each race, read FAQs, and see sponsors by tier. Volunteers should be able to sign up with a separate form. Add a countdown to race day, a menu that stays on screen and shows which section you are in, and a high-contrast mode that works across the whole page. It should feel sporty and clear and work well on phones.
  Race day: Sunday 14 February 2027. Expo day: Saturday 13 February 2027, 10am to 6pm, at Riverside Grounds, 5 River Road, Pune 411001. Races: 5K (start 7:30am, fee Rs 300, minimum age 12, cutoff 1 hour); 10K (start 6:45am, fee Rs 500, minimum age 16, cutoff 2 hours); Half Marathon (start 6:00am, fee Rs 800, minimum age 18, cutoff 3 hours 30 minutes). Event T-shirt: Rs 250 each, optional. Early-bird: 10% off race fees only (not T-shirts) for registrations up to 31 December 2026. Fee calculator: choose race, number of runners (1 to 10) and number of T-shirts; show the total. Water stations: 5K at 2.5 km; 10K at 2.5, 5 and 7.5 km; Half Marathon every 3 km. Use a placeholder for each route map. Registration form: name, email, phone, date of birth, race (dropdown), T-shirt yes/no, T-shirt size (only shown if T-shirt is yes), emergency contact name and phone, guardian name (only required if the runner is under 18); sends to run@example.com. Volunteer form: name, email, preferred role (Water station, Registration desk, Route marshal), available Saturday / Sunday / both; sends to volunteers@example.com. Schedule: Expo day 10am bib collection opens, 4pm route briefing, 6pm expo closes. Race day 5:00am gates open, 6:00am Half Marathon, 6:45am 10K, 7:30am 5K, 10:00am prize ceremony. FAQs: Can I change my race? Yes, until 31 January 2027 by email. Is there parking? Yes, free at Gate 2. Are refunds available? No. Where do I collect my bib? At the expo on 13 February. Is there a bag drop? Yes, near the start line. Are pacers provided? Yes, for the 10K and Half Marathon. Sponsors: Gold: Meridian Bank; Silver: Trailhead Sports, Aqua Pure; Community: Pune Runners Club. Contact: run@example.com, WhatsApp +91 00000 44444. No photos yet, use placeholders. We are offering S, M, L and XL.
@Requester Thanks, your brief covers everything I need. I'm passing it to the team to plan the site, and I'll tell you when it's ready.

proposal.name: Hero with event details and countdown
proposal.goal_gap: No page header showing the event, dates, venue or race-day countdown.

atoms.goal: The hero shows Riverside Run 2027, Pune, race day, expo day with time and venue, a self-updating countdown to 14 February 2027, and one main Register action.

No horizontal overflow at 360px

how.steps: Build section id hero. Inside it: h1 with Riverside Run 2027, text for Pune, race day Sunday 14 February 2027, expo day Saturday 13 February 2027, 10am to 6pm, at Riverside Grounds, 5 River Road, Pune 411001. Add div id j2-countdown holding exactly four elements with class j2-cd-unit (days, hours, minutes, seconds), each with a number span and a label. Add a script that updates them every second toward 14 February 2027 06:00 IST. Add one main link with classes j2-btn j2-btn-primary pointing to #register, labelled Register now.

how.steps: Build nav id site-nav, position fixed or sticky, with links of class j2-nav-link to #races, #calculator, #register, #schedule, #routes, #faq, #sponsors, #volunteer, #contact. Add button id contrast-toggle with class j2-btn that toggles class j2-hc on the body; define j2-hc overrides of the CSS colour variables for background, text, borders, buttons and cards.
